$comment: Single source of truth for how project-owned entities are handled when a project's resources change owner (user deletion with transfer, LDAP reset). Read by: OwnershipTransferService consumers via ownership-transfer.manifest.ts, the manifest guard test, and the n8n-local-rules/project-owned-entity-transfer lint rule via the eslint configs of @n8n/db and cli. Adding a new project-owned entity requires an entry here: either in 'transferred' (and handling in OwnershipTransferService.transferAllResources) or in 'notTransferred' with the reason for the decision. The 'path' pins the entry to the declaring file: the lint rule rejects a same-named entity in a different file, and the guard test fails when a listed file no longer declares the entity.

notTransferred.name: ActivityEvent
notTransferred.reason: Append-only record of what happened in the deleted project; re-homing entries would misstate where the events occurred. Dropped via FK cascade.

notTransferred.name: ProjectRelation
notTransferred.reason: Membership rows; they describe the deleted project itself.

notTransferred.name: ProjectSecretsProviderAccess
notTransferred.reason: Per-project secrets-provider config; scoped to the deleted project.

notTransferred.name: ProjectPoolSettings
notTransferred.reason: Per-project worker-pool config; scoped to the deleted project and dropped via FK cascade.

notTransferred.name: RoleMappingRule
notTransferred.reason: SSO role-mapping config attached to the project, not user data.

notTransferred.name: TypeAvailabilityPolicyScope
notTransferred.reason: Governance config attached to the project, not user data; dropped via FK cascade. Transferring it could not work anyway: a destination project may already own a scope of the same kind, which uq_type_availability_policy_scope_project rejects.

notTransferred.name: Variables
notTransferred.reason: Project-scoped variables are dropped via FK cascade; personal projects do not expose them.

notTransferred.name: Agent
notTransferred.reason: Dropped via FK cascade today. Revisit: agents created by the deleted user are lost on transfer.

notTransferred.name: Department
notTransferred.reason: Department ownership is project scoped. Delete it with its source project; do not move it to another project.

notTransferred.name: Member
notTransferred.reason: Member identity and hierarchy belong to the department project. Delete them with that project.

notTransferred.name: ExecutorBinding
notTransferred.reason: Executor bindings are project scoped and must not move across projects. Delete them with their member.

notTransferred.name: DirectoryChange
notTransferred.reason: Directory changes are an audit history of the source project. Keep them scoped to that project and delete them with it.

notTransferred.name: CommandReceipt
notTransferred.reason: Command receipts are idempotency records scoped to the source project. Delete them with that project.

notTransferred.name: DepartmentAdmissionFence
notTransferred.reason: Admission fences are internal concurrency records for the source project's departments. Delete them with the department.

notTransferred.name: DepartmentGoal
notTransferred.reason: Goals and their history belong to the source department. Delete them with the source project.

notTransferred.name: WorkItem
notTransferred.reason: Work and its execution ownership remain in the source project. Do not transfer work to a different project.

notTransferred.name: WorkAttempt
notTransferred.reason: Attempts reference executions owned by the source project and cannot be re-homed. Delete them with their work.

notTransferred.name: WorkDispatchIntent
notTransferred.reason: Dispatch intents are scoped to attempts in the source project. Delete them with their attempt.

notTransferred.name: WorkOwnerEventReceipt
notTransferred.reason: Owner event receipts record execution events from the source project. Delete them with their attempt.

notTransferred.name: WorkTransition
notTransferred.reason: Transitions are an audit history of work in the source project. Delete them with their work.

notTransferred.name: WorkReviewDecision
notTransferred.reason: Review decisions are part of source-project work history. Delete them with their work.

notTransferred.name: App
notTransferred.reason: Apps stay in their source project. The project FK cascade deletes apps and their versions.

notTransferred.name: AgentExecutionThread
notTransferred.reason: Dropped via FK cascade together with its Agent.

notTransferred.name: AgentChatAttachment
notTransferred.reason: Conversation attachments; dropped via FK cascade together with their Agent/project, like the threads and messages they belong to.

notTransferred.name: InstanceAiThread
notTransferred.reason: AI assistant conversation history; personal to the deleted user.

notTransferred.name: InsightsMetadata
notTransferred.reason: Denormalized analytics snapshot; historical insights keep the original project reference by design.

notTransferred.name: WorkflowReviewRequest
notTransferred.reason: Not transferred with the project. Open reviews are closed when their workflow is archived, moved to another project, or deleted (workflow lifecycle hooks); rows are removed via the projectId FK cascade when the source project itself is deleted, as in ownership-transfer flows. WorkflowReviewActivity and WorkflowReviewActivityComment ride this entity's cascade and have no projectId of their own, so they never appear in this manifest.

notTransferred.name: PromotionEnvironmentProject
notTransferred.reason: Promotion configuration for the project (which environment it uses for each direction), not user data. Dropped via the projectId FK cascade when the source project is deleted, as in ownership-transfer flows.

notTransferred.name: Skill
notTransferred.reason: Project-scoped skills belong to the project's agents, which are not transferred either (see Agent); both are dropped via FK cascade. Instance skills carry no projectId.

notTransferred.name: SkillSourceConnection
notTransferred.reason: A skill source has the scope of its synced skills, which are not transferred either (see Skill); both are dropped via FK cascade, with the source links. Global sources carry no projectId.

notTransferred.name: AiPreference
notTransferred.reason: Project-scoped AI preferences describe how to work inside the deleted project; dropped via FK cascade, like Variables. Personal and global preferences carry no projectId.

notTransferred.name: WorkflowSuggestion
notTransferred.reason: Keeps the original project and baseline. A workflow transfer makes the proposal ineligible. Deleted with its activity via FK cascade when the original project, workflow, or background user is deleted.

notTransferred.name: SelfHealingResult
notTransferred.reason: Keeps the original project and investigation identity. Deleted via FK cascade when the configuration, original project, workflow, background user, or linked suggestion is deleted. Configuration removal explicitly deletes linked suggestions.

notTransferred.name: SelfHealingInvestigation
notTransferred.reason: Keeps the original actor, project, and workflow baseline. A workflow transfer prevents completion. Deleted via FK cascade with the configuration, original project, workflow, background user, or completed result.

notTransferred.name: SelfHealingConfiguration
notTransferred.reason: Project settings remain in the original project. They are not transferred. Deleting the enabling user clears that reference. Deleting the source project deletes the configuration through its foreign key.

notTransferred.name: SelfHealingConfigurationWorkflow
notTransferred.reason: Workflow selections belong to the original project configuration. A transfer to another project removes them. Deleting the configuration, project, or workflow also removes them through its foreign key.

notTransferred.name: WorkRelationship
notTransferred.reason: Keeps the original project and work identity. Deleted with its work item through the foreign key cascade when the source project is deleted.

notTransferred.name: WorkClaim
notTransferred.reason: Keeps the original project and work identity. Deleted with its work item through the foreign key cascade when the source project is deleted.

notTransferred.name: WorkActivity
notTransferred.reason: Keeps the original project and work identity. Deleted with its work item through the foreign key cascade when the source project is deleted.

notTransferred.name: WorkWakeIntent
notTransferred.reason: Keeps the original project and work identity. Deleted with its work item through the foreign key cascade when the source project is deleted.

notTransferred.name: WorkWakeLane
notTransferred.reason: Wake state belongs to the original project member and initiating user. Delete it with the member; do not move it to another project.

notTransferred.name: WorkEligibility
notTransferred.reason: Eligibility history belongs to its original project work item and member. Delete it with either parent; do not transfer execution authority.
